mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases by more than 1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months, it signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and PAYEMS > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If both conditions are met and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 1% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) increases by more than 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months, it signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: If both conditions are met and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
